text: 在9月12日2026中国算力大会主论坛上，中国工程院院士邬贺铨指出，智能体的出现带动了Token的消费。今年3月，Token的消费已经达到日均140万亿。随着技术进步，Token的消耗并不是以多为荣，而是以效率为荣。中国Token的应用成本不断下降，这也促进了Token的利用。Token带动算力，算力和Token之间成正比。目前，中国的算力在全球占21%，美国占46%，按照国家算力网的规划，2030年中国算力有望占到全球30%。
text_en: At the main forum of the 2026 China Computing Conference on September 12, Chinese Academy of Engineering academician Wu Hequan pointed out that the emergence of intelligent agents has driven Token consumption. In March this year, Token consumption had already reached an average of 140 trillion per day. As technology advances, Token consumption is not about taking pride in using more, but about taking pride in efficiency. The application cost of Tokens in China continues to decline, which has also promoted Token utilization. Tokens drive computing power, and computing power and Tokens are directly proportional. At present, China accounts for 21% of global computing power, while the United States accounts for 46%. According to the national computing power network plan, China's computing power is expected to account for 30% of the global total by 2030.
